2:3.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
2:3.translation: those who believe in the unseen, establish prayer[1], and spend out of what We[2] have provided for them,
2:3.footnotes:
[1] At its proper times and fulfill its all conditions.
 [2] "We" in reference to Allah in the Qur’anic verses is necessarily understood to denote grandeur and power.

2:55.arabic_text: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهۡرَةٗ فَأَخَذَتۡكُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ
2:55.translation: And [remember] when you said, “O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah openly,” so a thunderbolt struck you while you were looking on.

2:77.arabic_text: أَوَلَا يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
2:77.translation: Do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal?

2:186.arabic_text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعۡوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِي وَلۡيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِي لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡشُدُونَ
2:186.translation: When My slaves ask you concerning Me, I am indeed near[1]. I respond to the call of the supplicant when he calls upon Me; so they should respond to Me and believe in Me, so that they may be guided.
2:186.footnotes: [1] Allah’s nearness means that one does not need to raise his voice or to ask for intercession in order that his prayers be answered.

2:255.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٞ وَلَا نَوۡمٞۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
2:255.translation: Allah: none has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Ever-Living[1], All-Sustaining[2]. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep[3]. To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except with His permission? He knows what was before them and what will be after them[4], while they encompass nothing of His knowledge, except what He wills. His Kursī[5] [i.e., footstool] extends over the heavens and earth, and safeguarding of both does not weary Him, for He is the Most High[6], the Most Great[7].[8]
2:255.footnotes:
[1] Whose life is perfect, complete, and eternal, without beginning or end.
 [2] Dependent on none for His existence while being the sustainer of all created beings.
 [3] Dozing off and falling asleep are but normal to all creation that are inherently frail.
 [4] Allah's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
 [5] Chair or footstool. It is not to be confused with al-‘Arsh (the Throne), which is infinitely higher and greater than al-Kursī.
 [6] Above all of His creations and superior to them in essence, rank, and position.
 [7] Whose greatness is unlimited, beyond description or imagination.
 [8] This verse is known as Āyat al-Kursī, lit. The verse of the Footstool. It is the greatest verse in the Qur’an.

3:123.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدۡرٖ وَأَنتُمۡ أَذِلَّةٞۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
3:123.translation: Allah had helped you at Badr when you were weak; then fear Allah so that you may be grateful.

3:136.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَجَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
3:136.translation: Their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. How excellent is the reward of those who do [righteous] deeds!

3:140.arabic_text: إِن يَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ قَرۡحٞ فَقَدۡ مَسَّ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ قَرۡحٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمۡ شُهَدَآءَۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
3:140.translation: If you have suffered a blow [at ’Uhud], they too have suffered a blow like it [at Badr]. We alternate among people these days, so that Allah may make evident the believers and may choose martyrs from among you. And Allah does not like the wrongdoers.

3:173.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدۡ جَمَعُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱخۡشَوۡهُمۡ فَزَادَهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَقَالُواْ حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ
3:173.translation: those[1] to whom people[2] said, “Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them.” But it only increased them in faith, and they said, “Allah is Sufficient for us, and He is the best Protector[3].”
3:173.footnotes:
[1] The believers.
 [2] The hypocrites.
 [3] This is one of the greatest Dhikr (remembrance) during times of hardship. Ibn ‘Abbās (رضي الله عنهما) reported: “Hasbunā Allāh wa ni‘ma al-Wakīl (Allah suffices us, He is the best of Protectors), was said by Abraham (عليه السلام) when he was thrown in the fire and was said by Muhammad (ﷺ) when it was said: “People have regrouped for you, so fear them”, their belief grew firmer and they said: “Allah suffices us, He is the best of Protectors”.” [Al-Bukhārī: 4563]

6:14.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيّٗا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُوَ يُطۡعِمُ وَلَا يُطۡعَمُۗ قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
6:14.translation: Say [O Prophet], “Should I take any guardian other than Allah, the Originator of the heavens and earth, Who feeds but is not fed?” Say, “I have been commanded to be the first to submit [to Allah] and not to be one of those who associate partners with Allah.”

6:82.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَمۡ يَلۡبِسُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلۡمٍ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡنُ وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
6:82.translation: Those who believe and do not mix their faith with falsehood[1] are the ones who will be secure, and it is they who are rightly guided.
6:82.footnotes: [1] i.e., they do not worship others besides Allah.

7:138.arabic_text: وَجَٰوَزۡنَا بِبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ فَأَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ يَعۡكُفُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَصۡنَامٖ لَّهُمۡۚ قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَى ٱجۡعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهٗا كَمَا لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞۚ قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٞ تَجۡهَلُونَ
7:138.translation: We led the Children of Israel across the sea, then they came upon a people who were devoted to their idols. They said, “O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods.” He said, “You are indeed an ignorant people.

8:10.arabic_text: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشۡرَىٰ وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمۡۚ وَمَا ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
8:10.translation: Allah granted this only as glad tidings and to reassure your hearts, for victory only comes from Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

9:40.arabic_text: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدۡ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثَانِيَ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ إِذۡ هُمَا فِي ٱلۡغَارِ إِذۡ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَاۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٖ لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلسُّفۡلَىٰۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِيَ ٱلۡعُلۡيَاۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
9:40.translation: If you do not support the Prophet, Allah has already supported him when the disbelievers forced him out; when he was second of the two[1] in the cave – saying to his companion, “Do not grieve; Allah is with us.” Thereupon Allah sent down His tranquility upon him, supported him with soldiers that you did not see[2], and rendered the word of the disbelievers[3] the lowest, whereas the Word of Allah[4] is supreme. And Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
9:40.footnotes:
[1] The second was his companion, Abu Bakr.
 [2] Angels came to the Prophet’s aid in the small cave.
 [3] i.e., their claims and slogans of disbelief.
 [4] i.e., "La ilaha illa Allah" (There is no true deity except Allah).

11:55.arabic_text: مِن دُونِهِۦۖ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
11:55.translation: with Him. So plot against me all together, then give me no respite.

11:56.arabic_text: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذُۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
11:56.translation: I put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature but He holds it by its forelock[1]. My Lord is on a straight path[2].
11:56.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Allah is in full control over all His creatures.
 [2] The path of Truth and Justice, as He Almighty does not deal anyone wrongfully.

12:33.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجۡنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِۖ وَإِلَّا تَصۡرِفۡ عَنِّي كَيۡدَهُنَّ أَصۡبُ إِلَيۡهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
12:33.translation: Joseph said, “My Lord, I would rather be in prison than that to which they are calling me. Unless you protect me from their guile, I may succumb to them and fall into ignorance.”

12:34.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَجَابَ لَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ فَصَرَفَ عَنۡهُ كَيۡدَهُنَّۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
12:34.translation: So his Lord answered his prayer and protected him from their guile. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

18:7.arabic_text: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ زِينَةٗ لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗا
18:7.translation: We have made all that is on earth as an adornment for it, so that We may test them as to which of them is best in deeds.

19:65.arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيّٗا
19:65.translation: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”

19:90.arabic_text: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
19:90.translation: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.

19:91.translation: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.

21:69.arabic_text: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدٗا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
21:69.translation: We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”[1]
21:69.footnotes: [1] It is reported in an authentic Hadīth that Abraham said, while being thrown into the fire, “Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Protector.”

21:87.arabic_text: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبٗا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
21:87.translation: And [remember] the Man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah] when he departed in anger[1], thinking that We would not take him to task. Then he cried out in the depths of darkness[2], “None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong”.
21:87.footnotes:
[1] Due to the disbelief of his people.
 [2] The darkness of the night, the sea, and the whale's belly.

21:88.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
21:88.translation: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress. This is how We rescue the believers.

22:11.arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعۡبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرۡفٖۖ فَإِنۡ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيۡرٌ ٱطۡمَأَنَّ بِهِۦۖ وَإِنۡ أَصَابَتۡهُ فِتۡنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
22:11.translation: There are some people who worship Allah on the edge [of faith][1]: if something good comes to them, they are content; but if they are afflicted with a trial, they turn back[2], thus losing both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.
22:11.footnotes:
[1] i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy, or heedlessness.
 [2] lit., they tumble on their faces, i.e., turn back to disbelief.

25:58.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
25:58.translation: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –

28:7.arabic_text: وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَرۡضِعِيهِۖ فَإِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَأَلۡقِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيٓۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
28:7.translation: We inspired the mother of Moses, “Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear or grieve. We will surely return him to you, and will make him one of the messengers.”

28:16.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
28:16.translation: He said, “My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me,” Then He forgave him, for He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

39:29.arabic_text: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
39:29.translation: Allah makes a comparison of a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master. Are they equal in comparison? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not know.

42:11.arabic_text: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
42:11.translation: the Originator of the heavens and earth. He has given you spouses of your own kind, and pairs of livestock; by which He causes you to multiply. There is nothing like unto Him[1], and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
42:11.footnotes: [1] In His essence, His attributes, or His deeds.

42:52.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
42:52.translation: Likewise, We have revealed to you a revelation by Our command. You knew nothing of the Scripture or matters of faith, but We have made it [i.e., the Qur’an] a light by which We guide whom We will of Our slaves. And you are truly leading people to a straight path,

55:29.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ
55:29.translation: All those in the heavens and earth ask of Him; every day He is engaged in some matters[1].
55:29.footnotes: [1] Such as giving life and causing death, enriching some and impoverishing others, elevating some and debasing others, etc.

57:3.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
57:3.translation: He is the First[1] and the Last[2], the Manifest[3] and the Hidden[4], and He is All-Knowing of everything.
57:3.footnotes:
[1] Before Whom nothing existed; the foremost; the uppermost.
 [2] Eternal after Whom nothing remains.
 [3] High, nothing is above Him.
 [4] Nothing is nearer than Him by way of His knowledge; concealed from our physical senses.

67:14.arabic_text: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
67:14.translation: Does He not know His Own creation[1], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?
67:14.footnotes: [1] Or does He not know those whom He created?

68:51.arabic_text: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
68:51.translation: The disbelievers would almost strike you down with their malicious gazes when they hear the Reminder, and they say, “He is certainly mad.”

72:2.arabic_text: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا
72:2.translation: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

73:6.arabic_text: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
73:6.translation: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[1] and more conducive to proper recitation[2].
73:6.footnotes:
[1] Or "getting up at night is more difficult...," meaning that it can only be done by sincere believers.
 [2] i.e., for reciting, hearing, and understanding of the Qur’an.

112:1.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.

112:2.footnotes: [1] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

112:3.translation: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

112:4.translation: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]
112:4.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) says that reading this surah (surat al-Ikhlās) equals reading one third of the Qur’an. [Al-Bukhāri and Muslim]

113:1.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,

114:1.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
full_parent.translation: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
full_parent.translation: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.

2.text: Likewise, We have revealed to you a revelation by Our command.

full_parent.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
full_parent.translation: Likewise, We have revealed to you a revelation by Our command. You knew nothing of the Scripture or matters of faith, but We have made it [i.e., the Qur’an] a light by which We guide whom We will of Our slaves. And you are truly leading people to a straight path,

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
full_parent.translation: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
full_parent.translation: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.

10.text: every day He is engaged in some matters[1]

full_parent.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ
full_parent.translation: All those in the heavens and earth ask of Him; every day He is engaged in some matters[1].
full_parent.footnotes: [1] Such as giving life and causing death, enriching some and impoverishing others, elevating some and debasing others, etc.

14.text: O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.
14.arabic_source: ﴿يَا نَارُ كُونِي بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدٗا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
full_parent.translation: We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”[1]
full_parent.footnotes: [1] It is reported in an authentic Hadīth that Abraham said, while being thrown into the fire, “Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Protector.”

16.text: Unless you protect me from their guile, I may succumb to them

full_parent.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجۡنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِۖ وَإِلَّا تَصۡرِفۡ عَنِّي كَيۡدَهُنَّ أَصۡبُ إِلَيۡهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
full_parent.translation: Joseph said, “My Lord, I would rather be in prison than that to which they are calling me. Unless you protect me from their guile, I may succumb to them and fall into ignorance.”

18.text: None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong
18.arabic_source: ﴿لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبٗا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
full_parent.translation: And [remember] the Man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah] when he departed in anger[1], thinking that We would not take him to task. Then he cried out in the depths of darkness[2], “None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong”.
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] Due to the disbelief of his people.
 [2] The darkness of the night, the sea, and the whale's belly.

19.text: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress.

full_parent.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
full_parent.translation: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress. This is how We rescue the believers.

21.text: Allah had helped you at Badr when you were weak

full_parent.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدۡرٖ وَأَنتُمۡ أَذِلَّةٞۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
full_parent.translation: Allah had helped you at Badr when you were weak; then fear Allah so that you may be grateful.

full_parent.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
full_parent.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[1].
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

28.text: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.
28.arabic_source: ﴿يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَنْ نُشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا
full_parent.translation: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

40.text: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[1] and more conducive to proper recitation[2].
40.arabic_source: ﴿إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
full_parent.translation: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[1] and more conducive to proper recitation[2].
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] Or "getting up at night is more difficult...," meaning that it can only be done by sincere believers.
 [2] i.e., for reciting, hearing, and understanding of the Qur’an.

full_parent.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
full_parent.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[1].
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

full_parent.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
full_parent.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[1].
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

46.text: Who feeds but is not fed

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيّٗا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُوَ يُطۡعِمُ وَلَا يُطۡعَمُۗ قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
full_parent.translation: Say [O Prophet], “Should I take any guardian other than Allah, the Originator of the heavens and earth, Who feeds but is not fed?” Say, “I have been commanded to be the first to submit [to Allah] and not to be one of those who associate partners with Allah.”

51.text: when you fear for him, cast him into the river

full_parent.arabic_text: وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَرۡضِعِيهِۖ فَإِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَأَلۡقِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيٓۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
full_parent.translation: We inspired the mother of Moses, “Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear or grieve. We will surely return him to you, and will make him one of the messengers.”

53.text: So plot against me all together, then give me no respite.

full_parent.arabic_text: مِن دُونِهِۦۖ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
full_parent.translation: with Him. So plot against me all together, then give me no respite.

54.text: I put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord.

full_parent.arabic_text: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذُۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
full_parent.translation: I put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature but He holds it by its forelock[1]. My Lord is on a straight path[2].
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Allah is in full control over all His creatures.
 [2] The path of Truth and Justice, as He Almighty does not deal anyone wrongfully.

55.text: My Lord is on a straight path[2].

full_parent.arabic_text: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذُۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
full_parent.translation: I put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature but He holds it by its forelock[1]. My Lord is on a straight path[2].
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Allah is in full control over all His creatures.
 [2] The path of Truth and Justice, as He Almighty does not deal anyone wrongfully.

58.text: Those who believe and do not mix their faith with falsehood[1] are the ones who will be secure, and it is they who are rightly guided.
58.arabic_source: ﴿الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوا إِيمَانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الْأَمْنُ وَهُمْ مُهْتَدُونَ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَمۡ يَلۡبِسُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلۡمٍ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡنُ وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
full_parent.translation: Those who believe and do not mix their faith with falsehood[1] are the ones who will be secure, and it is they who are rightly guided.
full_parent.footnotes: [1] i.e., they do not worship others besides Allah.

full_parent.arabic_text: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشۡرَىٰ وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمۡۚ وَمَا ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
full_parent.translation: Allah granted this only as glad tidings and to reassure your hearts, for victory only comes from Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

full_parent.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
full_parent.translation: He is the First[1] and the Last[2], the Manifest[3] and the Hidden[4], and He is All-Knowing of everything.
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] Before Whom nothing existed; the foremost; the uppermost.
 [2] Eternal after Whom nothing remains.
 [3] High, nothing is above Him.
 [4] Nothing is nearer than Him by way of His knowledge; concealed from our physical senses.

72.text: Do not grieve; Allah is with us.

full_parent.arabic_text: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدۡ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثَانِيَ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ إِذۡ هُمَا فِي ٱلۡغَارِ إِذۡ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَاۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٖ لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلسُّفۡلَىٰۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِيَ ٱلۡعُلۡيَاۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
full_parent.translation: If you do not support the Prophet, Allah has already supported him when the disbelievers forced him out; when he was second of the two[1] in the cave – saying to his companion, “Do not grieve; Allah is with us.” Thereupon Allah sent down His tranquility upon him, supported him with soldiers that you did not see[2], and rendered the word of the disbelievers[3] the lowest, whereas the Word of Allah[4] is supreme. And Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] The second was his companion, Abu Bakr.
 [2] Angels came to the Prophet’s aid in the small cave.
 [3] i.e., their claims and slogans of disbelief.
 [4] i.e., "La ilaha illa Allah" (There is no true deity except Allah).

74.text: those who believe in the unseen

full_parent.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
full_parent.translation: those who believe in the unseen, establish prayer[1], and spend out of what We[2] have provided for them,
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] At its proper times and fulfill its all conditions.
 [2] "We" in reference to Allah in the Qur’anic verses is necessarily understood to denote grandeur and power.

76.text: There are some people who worship Allah on the edge [of faith][1]: if something good comes to them, they are content
76.arabic_source: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرْفٍ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ خَيْرٌ اطْمَأَنَّ بِهِ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعۡبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرۡفٖۖ فَإِنۡ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيۡرٌ ٱطۡمَأَنَّ بِهِۦۖ وَإِنۡ أَصَابَتۡهُ فِتۡنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
full_parent.translation: There are some people who worship Allah on the edge [of faith][1]: if something good comes to them, they are content; but if they are afflicted with a trial, they turn back[2], thus losing both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.
full_parent.footnotes:
[1] i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy, or heedlessness.
 [2] lit., they tumble on their faces, i.e., turn back to disbelief.

78.text: We alternate among people these days

full_parent.arabic_text: إِن يَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ قَرۡحٞ فَقَدۡ مَسَّ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ قَرۡحٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمۡ شُهَدَآءَۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
full_parent.translation: If you have suffered a blow [at ’Uhud], they too have suffered a blow like it [at Badr]. We alternate among people these days, so that Allah may make evident the believers and may choose martyrs from among you. And Allah does not like the wrongdoers.

80.text: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies

full_parent.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
full_parent.translation: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –

87.text: Does He not know His Own creation[1], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?
87.arabic_source: ﴿أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
full_parent.translation: Does He not know His Own creation[1], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?
full_parent.footnotes: [1] Or does He not know those whom He created?

91.text: How excellent is the reward of those who do [righteous] deeds!

full_parent.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَجَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
full_parent.translation: Their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. How excellent is the reward of those who do [righteous] deeds!

full_parent.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
full_parent.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[1].
full_parent.footnotes: [1] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

94.text: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

full_parent.arabic_text: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ
full_parent.translation: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

95.text: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

full_parent.arabic_text: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ
full_parent.translation: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

99.text: When My slaves ask you concerning Me, I am indeed near[1].

full_parent.arabic_text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعۡوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِي وَلۡيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِي لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡشُدُونَ
full_parent.translation: When My slaves ask you concerning Me, I am indeed near[1]. I respond to the call of the supplicant when he calls upon Me; so they should respond to Me and believe in Me, so that they may be guided.
full_parent.footnotes: [1] Allah’s nearness means that one does not need to raise his voice or to ask for intercession in order that his prayers be answered.

103a.text: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.
103a.arabic_source: ﴿تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا ۝ أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
full_parent.translation: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.

103b.text: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.
103b.arabic_source: ﴿تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنْشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا ۝ أَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًا﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٗا
full_parent.translation: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.

105.text: My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me,

full_parent.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
full_parent.translation: He said, “My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me,” Then He forgave him, for He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

full_parent.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
full_parent.translation: He said, “My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me,” Then He forgave him, for He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

108.text: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]

full_parent.arabic_text: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
full_parent.translation: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]
full_parent.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) says that reading this surah (surat al-Ikhlās) equals reading one third of the Qur’an. [Al-Bukhāri and Muslim]

109.text: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]

full_parent.arabic_text: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
full_parent.translation: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]
full_parent.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) says that reading this surah (surat al-Ikhlās) equals reading one third of the Qur’an. [Al-Bukhāri and Muslim]

110.text: Do you know anyone equal to Him?

full_parent.arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيّٗا
full_parent.translation: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”

112.text: There is nothing like unto Him[1]

full_parent.arabic_text: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
full_parent.translation: the Originator of the heavens and earth. He has given you spouses of your own kind, and pairs of livestock; by which He causes you to multiply. There is nothing like unto Him[1], and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
full_parent.footnotes: [1] In His essence, His attributes, or His deeds.

114.text: Do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal?
114.arabic_source: ﴿أَوَلَا يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: أَوَلَا يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
full_parent.translation: Do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal?

116.text: we will never believe you until we see Allah openly
116.arabic_source: ﴿لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهۡرَةٗ فَأَخَذَتۡكُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ
full_parent.translation: And [remember] when you said, “O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah openly,” so a thunderbolt struck you while you were looking on.

118.text: make for us a god just as they have gods.

full_parent.arabic_text: وَجَٰوَزۡنَا بِبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ فَأَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ يَعۡكُفُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَصۡنَامٖ لَّهُمۡۚ قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَى ٱجۡعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهٗا كَمَا لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞۚ قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٞ تَجۡهَلُونَ
full_parent.translation: We led the Children of Israel across the sea, then they came upon a people who were devoted to their idols. They said, “O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods.” He said, “You are indeed an ignorant people.

120.text: a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master
120.arabic_source: ﴿رَجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِرَجُلٍ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
full_parent.translation: Allah makes a comparison of a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master. Are they equal in comparison? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not know.

122.text: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ
full_parent.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,

124.text: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

full_parent.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
full_parent.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

129.text: The disbelievers would almost strike you down with their malicious gazes when they hear the Reminder
129.arabic_source: ﴿وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ﴾

full_parent.arabic_text: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
full_parent.translation: The disbelievers would almost strike you down with their malicious gazes when they hear the Reminder, and they say, “He is certainly mad.”

12.text: Allah is Sufficient for us, and He is the best Protector[3].
12.narrator: Ibn ‘Abbas reporting Abraham; not a replacement by the later Muhammad episode

24.text: is equivalent to a third of the Qur'an.
24.selection: Final predicate only; surah named by commentary outside quote. No HadeethEnc Abu Sa‘id parallel selected and no alternative Quran translation imported.

30.text: that they should worship Him (Alone) and should not worship any besides Him.

32.grade: Hasan attributed to Darussalam on the actual parent

34.attribution: Ibn Hisham’s historical statement; no displayed chain; no Prophetic grading inferred

36.text: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Alone Who has no partners, to Him belongs Dominion and to Him belong all the Praises, and He has power over all things
36.selection: Complete dhikr up to publisher’s following explanatory parenthesis; didactic unchanged selection. Its hundred-daily setting is retained in commentary; additional parent rewards are not invented into supplied source.

49.text: the weaned camel calf yearned for its mother
49.reference: Supplied Arabic linguistic illustration; reported proposal, not scripture or hadith
49.qualification: Competing etymologies retained; vivid weaning and bleating details belong to supplied illustration and are not certified as a verbatim Ibn Kathir passage.

60.text: There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment.
60.selection: Complete published hadith sentence; Arabic sent-down idiom is interpreted as created by this edition. It preserves disease and corresponding remedy, with no immediate cure promise; no correction of publication.

62.text: heal the patient, for You are the Healer. No healing is of any avail but Yours
62.selection: Coherent unchanged prayer excerpt; no different Muslim/HadeethEnc version attributed as this one.

70.text: O Abu Bakr! What do you think of two (persons) the third of whom is Allah?
70.qualification: Cave context and divine support; no physical indwelling/location claim.

82.text: I have sought shelter for my back with You
82.qualification: Direct meaning preserves source’s back/shelter image. Existing publication interprets it as dependence. Full parent hope/fear and bedtime context read. Not represented as published English.

84.text: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee
84.selection: Unchanged whole opening formula; archaic Thou/Thee confined to exact quotation, modern commentary outside.

89.text: to make the Quran the springtime of my heart, the light of my chest, the clearing of my sorrow, and the removal of my worry

all26routes.context: فُ الْخَبِيرُ﴾ [الملك: 14]. ومن الدعاء الذي يجمع سؤال الله بأسمائه والانتفاع بكلامه أن يسأله العبد: «أن تجعل القرآن ربيع قلبي، ونور صدري، وجلاء حزني، وذهاب همي» [أحمد: 3712]. ولا يثبت هذا التوجه بسماع الموعظة وحده؛ فالعمل يغرس في القلب قدر ما يعمل له صاحبه. الإنسان لا ي

entries.actual_current_arabic: وروي عن ابن عباس تفسيره بالسيد الذي كمل في سؤدده، أي سيادته، والحليم الذي كمل في حلمه، والغني الذي كمل في غناه، والعالم الذي كمل في علمه، والحكيم الذي كمل في حكمته [البيهقي، الأسماء والصفات: 98].
entries.primary_section: أصول الحديث، الأسماء والصفات للبيهقي (1/156)، item 98
entries.full_bounded_arabic_parent: 98 - أخبرنا أبو زكريا بن أبي إسحاق المزكي , أنا أبو الحسن أحمد بن محمد بن عبدوس الطرائفي , ثنا عثمان بن سعيد الدارمي , ثنا عبد الله بن صالح , عن معاوية بن صالح , عن علي بن أبي طلحة , عن ابن عباس , رضي الله عنهما في قوله: {الصمد} [[الإخلاص: 2]] قال: السيد الذي كمل في سؤدده والشريف الذي كمل في شرفه والعظيم الذي قد كمل في عظمته , والحليم الذي قد كمل في حلمه , والغني الذي قد كمل في غناه , والجبار الذي قد كمل في جبروته , والعالم الذي قد كمل في علمه , والحكيم الذي قد كمل في حكمه , وهو الذي قد كمل في أنواع الشرف والسؤدد وهو الله عز وجل هذه صفته لا تنبغي إلا له ليس له كفو وليس كمثله شيء , فسبحان الله الواحد القهار
entries.reading: Actual current Arabic selects five noncontiguous predicates from a longer attributed statement. Preserve that it is reported from Ibn Abbas through Ali ibn Abi Talha, not a complete uninterrupted literal quote or Prophetic narration. Bayhaqi’s printed wording حكمه differs from current source حكمته and Tabari parallel; record actual variant, do not silently claim verbatim full quotation. No independent chain authenticity conclusion inferred. MAIN can render directly from source Arabic as attributed non-Quran meaning after source comparison.

entries.actual_current_arabic: ولتقريب ما في هذا التعلق من شوق وافتقار، ذُكر في بعض الأقوال اللغوية قولهم: «أَلِهَ الفصيلُ إلى أمه»؛ والفصيل ولد الناقة بعد فطامه، إذا فُصل عنها اشتد حنينه إليها، حتى يصدر رغاءه كأنه يشكو أنه لا يطيق بعدها. وقد قيل بارتباط هذا المعنى باشتقاق اسم «الله»، وهو قول يُحكى، لا اشتقاق يُجزم به. والمقصود من الصورة تقريب حال القلب المتلهف، لا تشبيه الله بخلقه
entries.bounded_parent_arabic: وقيل: اشتقاقه من أله الفصيل، إذ ولع بأمه، والمعنى: أن العباد مألوهون مولعون بالتضرع إليه في كل الأحوال، قال: وقيل: مشتق من أله الرجل يأله: إذا فزع من أمر نزل به فألهه، أي: أجاره
entries.surrounding_context: The actually read Ibn Kathir passage explicitly gives multiple opinions, including underived proper name and alternative roots; al-Razi is reported as choosing underived. The supplied vivid weaning/bleating detail is its own illustration; the cited Ibn Kathir passage does not establish each of those details. No attribution of the illustration verbatim to Ibn Kathir. selected.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
selected.translation: those who believe in the unseen, establish prayer[1], and spend out of what We[2] have provided for them,
selected.footnotes:
[1] At its proper times and fulfill its all conditions.
 [2] "We" in reference to Allah in the Qur’anic verses is necessarily understood to denote grandeur and power.

selected.arabic_text: وَإِذۡ قُلۡتُمۡ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤۡمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى ٱللَّهَ جَهۡرَةٗ فَأَخَذَتۡكُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمۡ تَنظُرُونَ
selected.translation: And [remember] when you said, “O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah openly,” so a thunderbolt struck you while you were looking on.

selected.arabic_text: أَوَلَا يَعۡلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
selected.translation: Do they not know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal?

selected.arabic_text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌۖ أُجِيبُ دَعۡوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِۖ فَلۡيَسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِي وَلۡيُؤۡمِنُواْ بِي لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡشُدُونَ
selected.translation: When My slaves ask you concerning Me, I am indeed near[1]. I respond to the call of the supplicant when he calls upon Me; so they should respond to Me and believe in Me, so that they may be guided.
selected.footnotes: [1] Allah’s nearness means that one does not need to raise his voice or to ask for intercession in order that his prayers be answered.

selected.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡحَيُّ ٱلۡقَيُّومُۚ لَا تَأۡخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٞ وَلَا نَوۡمٞۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَشۡفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذۡنِهِۦۚ يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيۡءٖ مِّنۡ عِلۡمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَۚ وَسِعَ كُرۡسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفۡظُهُمَاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيُّ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
selected.translation: Allah: none has the right to be worshiped except Him, the Ever-Living[1], All-Sustaining[2]. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep[3]. To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except with His permission? He knows what was before them and what will be after them[4], while they encompass nothing of His knowledge, except what He wills. His Kursī[5] [i.e., footstool] extends over the heavens and earth, and safeguarding of both does not weary Him, for He is the Most High[6], the Most Great[7].[8]
selected.footnotes:
[1] Whose life is perfect, complete, and eternal, without beginning or end.
 [2] Dependent on none for His existence while being the sustainer of all created beings.
 [3] Dozing off and falling asleep are but normal to all creation that are inherently frail.
 [4] Allah's knowledge encompasses every aspect of His creations in the past, present and future.
 [5] Chair or footstool. It is not to be confused with al-‘Arsh (the Throne), which is infinitely higher and greater than al-Kursī.
 [6] Above all of His creations and superior to them in essence, rank, and position.
 [7] Whose greatness is unlimited, beyond description or imagination.
 [8] This verse is known as Āyat al-Kursī, lit. The verse of the Footstool. It is the greatest verse in the Qur’an.

selected.arabic_text: وَلَقَدۡ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدۡرٖ وَأَنتُمۡ أَذِلَّةٞۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
selected.translation: Allah had helped you at Badr when you were weak; then fear Allah so that you may be grateful.

selected.arabic_text: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡ وَجَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَنِعۡمَ أَجۡرُ ٱلۡعَٰمِلِينَ
selected.translation: Their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens under which rivers flow, abiding therein forever. How excellent is the reward of those who do [righteous] deeds!

selected.arabic_text: إِن يَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ قَرۡحٞ فَقَدۡ مَسَّ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ قَرۡحٞ مِّثۡلُهُۥۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمۡ شُهَدَآءَۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
selected.translation: If you have suffered a blow [at ’Uhud], they too have suffered a blow like it [at Badr]. We alternate among people these days, so that Allah may make evident the believers and may choose martyrs from among you. And Allah does not like the wrongdoers.

selected.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدۡ جَمَعُواْ لَكُمۡ فَٱخۡشَوۡهُمۡ فَزَادَهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَقَالُواْ حَسۡبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلۡوَكِيلُ
selected.translation: those[1] to whom people[2] said, “Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them.” But it only increased them in faith, and they said, “Allah is Sufficient for us, and He is the best Protector[3].”
selected.footnotes:
[1] The believers.
 [2] The hypocrites.
 [3] This is one of the greatest Dhikr (remembrance) during times of hardship. Ibn ‘Abbās (رضي الله عنهما) reported: “Hasbunā Allāh wa ni‘ma al-Wakīl (Allah suffices us, He is the best of Protectors), was said by Abraham (عليه السلام) when he was thrown in the fire and was said by Muhammad (ﷺ) when it was said: “People have regrouped for you, so fear them”, their belief grew firmer and they said: “Allah suffices us, He is the best of Protectors”.” [Al-Bukhārī: 4563]

selected.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ أَتَّخِذُ وَلِيّٗا فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَهُوَ يُطۡعِمُ وَلَا يُطۡعَمُۗ قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَۖ وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
selected.translation: Say [O Prophet], “Should I take any guardian other than Allah, the Originator of the heavens and earth, Who feeds but is not fed?” Say, “I have been commanded to be the first to submit [to Allah] and not to be one of those who associate partners with Allah.”

selected.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَمۡ يَلۡبِسُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنَهُم بِظُلۡمٍ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡأَمۡنُ وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
selected.translation: Those who believe and do not mix their faith with falsehood[1] are the ones who will be secure, and it is they who are rightly guided.
selected.footnotes: [1] i.e., they do not worship others besides Allah.

selected.arabic_text: وَجَٰوَزۡنَا بِبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ فَأَتَوۡاْ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمٖ يَعۡكُفُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَصۡنَامٖ لَّهُمۡۚ قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَى ٱجۡعَل لَّنَآ إِلَٰهٗا كَمَا لَهُمۡ ءَالِهَةٞۚ قَالَ إِنَّكُمۡ قَوۡمٞ تَجۡهَلُونَ
selected.translation: We led the Children of Israel across the sea, then they came upon a people who were devoted to their idols. They said, “O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods.” He said, “You are indeed an ignorant people.

selected.arabic_text: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشۡرَىٰ وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ بِهِۦ قُلُوبُكُمۡۚ وَمَا ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
selected.translation: Allah granted this only as glad tidings and to reassure your hearts, for victory only comes from Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

selected.arabic_text: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدۡ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثَانِيَ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ إِذۡ هُمَا فِي ٱلۡغَارِ إِذۡ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَاۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٖ لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلسُّفۡلَىٰۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِيَ ٱلۡعُلۡيَاۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
selected.translation: If you do not support the Prophet, Allah has already supported him when the disbelievers forced him out; when he was second of the two[1] in the cave – saying to his companion, “Do not grieve; Allah is with us.” Thereupon Allah sent down His tranquility upon him, supported him with soldiers that you did not see[2], and rendered the word of the disbelievers[3] the lowest, whereas the Word of Allah[4] is supreme. And Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
selected.footnotes:
[1] The second was his companion, Abu Bakr.
 [2] Angels came to the Prophet’s aid in the small cave.
 [3] i.e., their claims and slogans of disbelief.
 [4] i.e., "La ilaha illa Allah" (There is no true deity except Allah).

selected.arabic_text: مِن دُونِهِۦۖ فَكِيدُونِي جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
selected.translation: with Him. So plot against me all together, then give me no respite.

selected.arabic_text: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذُۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
selected.translation: I put my trust in Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no moving creature but He holds it by its forelock[1]. My Lord is on a straight path[2].
selected.footnotes:
[1] i.e., Allah is in full control over all His creatures.
 [2] The path of Truth and Justice, as He Almighty does not deal anyone wrongfully.

selected.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱلسِّجۡنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدۡعُونَنِيٓ إِلَيۡهِۖ وَإِلَّا تَصۡرِفۡ عَنِّي كَيۡدَهُنَّ أَصۡبُ إِلَيۡهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡجَٰهِلِينَ
selected.translation: Joseph said, “My Lord, I would rather be in prison than that to which they are calling me. Unless you protect me from their guile, I may succumb to them and fall into ignorance.”

selected.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَجَابَ لَهُۥ رَبُّهُۥ فَصَرَفَ عَنۡهُ كَيۡدَهُنَّۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
selected.translation: So his Lord answered his prayer and protected him from their guile. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

selected.arabic_text: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ زِينَةٗ لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ أَيُّهُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗا
selected.translation: We have made all that is on earth as an adornment for it, so that We may test them as to which of them is best in deeds.

selected.arabic_text: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فَٱعۡبُدۡهُ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦۚ هَلۡ تَعۡلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيّٗا
selected.translation: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them. So worship Him and be constant in worshiping Him. Do you know anyone equal to Him?”

selected.arabic_text: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
selected.translation: at which the heavens are about to be torn apart, the earth split asunder, and the mountains tumble down.

selected.arabic_text: أَن دَعَوۡاْ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٗا
selected.translation: because they have ascribed to the Most Compassionate a son.

selected.arabic_text: قُلۡنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِي بَرۡدٗا وَسَلَٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ
selected.translation: We said, “O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.”[1]
selected.footnotes: [1] It is reported in an authentic Hadīth that Abraham said, while being thrown into the fire, “Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Protector.”

selected.arabic_text: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِبٗا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبۡحَٰنَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
selected.translation: And [remember] the Man of the Whale [i.e., Jonah] when he departed in anger[1], thinking that We would not take him to task. Then he cried out in the depths of darkness[2], “None has the right to be worshiped except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong”.
selected.footnotes:
[1] Due to the disbelief of his people.
 [2] The darkness of the night, the sea, and the whale's belly.

selected.arabic_text: فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِي ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
selected.translation: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from distress. This is how We rescue the believers.

selected.arabic_text: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَعۡبُدُ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ حَرۡفٖۖ فَإِنۡ أَصَابَهُۥ خَيۡرٌ ٱطۡمَأَنَّ بِهِۦۖ وَإِنۡ أَصَابَتۡهُ فِتۡنَةٌ ٱنقَلَبَ عَلَىٰ وَجۡهِهِۦ خَسِرَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡخُسۡرَانُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
selected.translation: There are some people who worship Allah on the edge [of faith][1]: if something good comes to them, they are content; but if they are afflicted with a trial, they turn back[2], thus losing both this world and the Hereafter. That is the evident loss.
selected.footnotes:
[1] i.e., with uncertainty, hypocrisy, or heedlessness.
 [2] lit., they tumble on their faces, i.e., turn back to disbelief.

selected.arabic_text: وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱلۡحَيِّ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِهِۦۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
selected.translation: Put your trust in the Ever-Living Who never dies, and glorify Him with praise. He is Sufficient as All-Aware of the sins of His slaves –

selected.arabic_text: وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَرۡضِعِيهِۖ فَإِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَأَلۡقِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِي وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيٓۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
selected.translation: We inspired the mother of Moses, “Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear or grieve. We will surely return him to you, and will make him one of the messengers.”

selected.arabic_text: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
selected.translation: He said, “My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me,” Then He forgave him, for He is indeed the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

selected.arabic_text: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا رَّجُلٗا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلٗا سَلَمٗا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًاۚ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِۚ بَلۡ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
selected.translation: Allah makes a comparison of a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master. Are they equal in comparison? All praise be to Allah. But most of them do not know.

selected.arabic_text: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ أَزۡوَٰجٗا وَمِنَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ أَزۡوَٰجٗا يَذۡرَؤُكُمۡ فِيهِۚ لَيۡسَ كَمِثۡلِهِۦ شَيۡءٞۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡبَصِيرُ
selected.translation: the Originator of the heavens and earth. He has given you spouses of your own kind, and pairs of livestock; by which He causes you to multiply. There is nothing like unto Him[1], and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
selected.footnotes: [1] In His essence, His attributes, or His deeds.

selected.arabic_text: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَيۡكَ رُوحٗا مِّنۡ أَمۡرِنَاۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدۡرِي مَا ٱلۡكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلۡإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلۡنَٰهُ نُورٗا نَّهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَاۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهۡدِيٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
selected.translation: Likewise, We have revealed to you a revelation by Our command. You knew nothing of the Scripture or matters of faith, but We have made it [i.e., the Qur’an] a light by which We guide whom We will of Our slaves. And you are truly leading people to a straight path,

selected.arabic_text: يَسۡـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأۡنٖ
selected.translation: All those in the heavens and earth ask of Him; every day He is engaged in some matters[1].
selected.footnotes: [1] Such as giving life and causing death, enriching some and impoverishing others, elevating some and debasing others, etc.

selected.arabic_text: هُوَ ٱلۡأَوَّلُ وَٱلۡأٓخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلۡبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٌ
selected.translation: He is the First[1] and the Last[2], the Manifest[3] and the Hidden[4], and He is All-Knowing of everything.
selected.footnotes:
[1] Before Whom nothing existed; the foremost; the uppermost.
 [2] Eternal after Whom nothing remains.
 [3] High, nothing is above Him.
 [4] Nothing is nearer than Him by way of His knowledge; concealed from our physical senses.

selected.arabic_text: أَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
selected.translation: Does He not know His Own creation[1], when He is the Most Subtle, the All-Aware?
selected.footnotes: [1] Or does He not know those whom He created?

selected.arabic_text: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
selected.translation: The disbelievers would almost strike you down with their malicious gazes when they hear the Reminder, and they say, “He is certainly mad.”

selected.arabic_text: يَهۡدِيٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشۡدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ وَلَن نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدٗا
selected.translation: that guides to the right way, so we have believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.

selected.arabic_text: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
selected.translation: Indeed, worship at night is more effective[1] and more conducive to proper recitation[2].
selected.footnotes:
[1] Or "getting up at night is more difficult...," meaning that it can only be done by sincere believers.
 [2] i.e., for reciting, hearing, and understanding of the Qur’an.

selected.arabic_text: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
selected.translation: Say: “He is Allah, the One[1];
selected.footnotes: [1] He is Alone, without a partner, indivisible and distinct from all else. The only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes, and actions.

selected.arabic_text: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
selected.translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge[1].
selected.footnotes: [1] He is absolute, perfect, complete, self-sufficient; the one eternally and constantly required and sought; all existence depend upon Him; all matters ultimately return to Him.

selected.arabic_text: لَمۡ يَلِدۡ وَلَمۡ يُولَدۡ
selected.translation: He neither begets nor is He begotten,

selected.arabic_text: وَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ
selected.translation: and there is none comparable to Him.”[1]
selected.footnotes: [1] The Prophet (ﷺ) says that reading this surah (surat al-Ikhlās) equals reading one third of the Qur’an. [Al-Bukhāri and Muslim]

selected.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ
selected.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of the daybreak,

selected.arabic_text: قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
selected.translation: Say, “I seek refuge with the Lord of mankind,

MUSLIM-811A-COMPLETE-PARENT.json.english: Abu Darda' reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Is any one of you incapable of reciting a third of the Qur'an in a night? They (the Companions) asked: How could one recite a third of the Qur'an (in a night)? Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: "'Say: He is Allah, One' (Qur'an. cxii) is equivalent to a third of the Qur'an."
MUSLIM-811A-COMPLETE-PARENT.json.arabic: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏" قَالُوا : وَكَيْفَ يَقْرَأْ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ ؟ قَالَ : " قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ " ‏.‏

L66: Narrated Mu`adh:
L67: I was a companion rider of the Prophet (ﷺ) on a donkey called 'Ufair. The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "O Mu`adh! Do you know what Allah's right on His slaves is, and what the right of His slaves on Him is?" I replied, "Allah and His Apostle know better." He said, "Allah's right on His slaves is that they should worship Him (Alone) and should not worship any besides Him.
L68: And slave's right on Allah is that He should not punish him who worships none besides Him." I said, "O Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)! Should I not inform the people of this good news?" He said, "Do not inform them of it, lest they should depend on it (absolutely).
L69: حَدَّثَنِي 【10†إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ】، سَمِعَ 【11†يَحْيَى بْنَ آدَمَ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【12†أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ】، عَنْ 【13†أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ】، عَنْ 【14†عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ】، عَنْ 【15†مُعَاذٍ】 ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كُنْتُ رِدْفَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى حِمَارٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ عُفَيْرٌ، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا مُعَاذُ، هَلْ تَدْرِي حَقَّ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ وَمَا حَقُّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ حَقَّ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْعِبَادِ أَنْ يَعْبُدُوهُ وَلاَ يُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا، وَحَقَّ الْعِبَادِ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ لاَ يُعَذِّبَ مَنْ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَفَلاَ أُبَشِّرُ بِهِ النَّاسَ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُبَشِّرْهُمْ فَيَتَّكِلُوا ‏"‏‏.‏

L55: Sunan Ibn Majah 150
L56: It was narrated that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud said:
L57: "The first people to declare their Islam publicly were seven: The Messenger of Allah, Abu Bakr, 'Ammar and his mother Sumayyah, Suhaib, Bilal and Miqdad. With regard to the Messenger of Allah, Allah protected him through his paternal uncle Abu Talib. With regard to Abu Bakr, Allah protected him through his people. As for the rest, the idolators seized them and made them wear coats of chain-mail and exposed them to the intense heat of the sun.
L58: There was none of them who did not do what they wanted them to do, except for Bilal. He did not care what happened to him for the sake of Allah, and his people did not care what happened to him. Then they gave him to the children who took him around in the streets of Makkah while he was saying, 'Ahad, Ahad (One, One).'"
L59: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【11†يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【12†زَائِدَةُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ】، عَنْ 【13†عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ】، عَنْ 【14†زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ】، عَنْ 【15†عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ】، قَالَ كَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَظْهَرَ إِسْلاَمَهُ سَبْعَةٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعَمَّارٌ وَأُمُّهُ سُمَيَّةُ وَصُهَيْبٌ وَبِلاَلٌ وَالْمِقْدَادُ فَأَمَّا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ـ صلى الله عليه وسلم ـ فَمَنَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِعَمِّهِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَأَمَّا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَمَنَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمِهِ وَأَمَّا سَائِرُهُمْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ وَأَلْبَسُوهُمْ أَدْرَاعَ الْحَدِيدِ وَصَهَرُوهُمْ فِي الشَّمْسِ فَمَا مِنْهُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ وَاتَاهُمْ عَلَى مَا أَرَادُوا إِلاَّ بِلاَلاً فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ هَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ نَفْسُهُ فِي اللَّهِ وَهَانَ عَلَى قَوْمِهِ فَأَخَذُوهُ فَأَعْطَوْهُ الْوِلْدَانَ فَجَعَلُوا يَطُوفُونَ بِهِ فِي شِعَابِ مَكَّةَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ أَحَدٌ أَحَدٌ ‏.‏

L66: Narrated Abu Huraira:
L67: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "If one says one-hundred times in one day: "None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, the Alone Who has no partners, to Him belongs Dominion and to Him belong all the Praises, and He has power over all things (i.e.
L68: Omnipotent)", one will get the reward of manumitting ten slaves, and one-hundred good deeds will be written in his account, and one-hundred bad deeds will be wiped off or erased from his account, and on that day he will be protected from the morning till evening from Satan, and nobody will be superior to him except one who has done more than that which he has done."
L69: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ】، أَخْبَرَنَا 【11†مَالِكٌ】، عَنْ 【12†سُمَىٍّ،】 مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ 【13†أَبِي صَالِحٍ】، عَنْ 【14†أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ】 ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ‏.‏ فِي يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ، كَانَتْ لَهُ عَدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ، وَكُتِبَتْ لَهُ مِائَةُ حَسَنَةٍ، وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ مِائَةُ سَيِّئَةٍ، وَكَانَتْ لَهُ حِرْزًا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَلَمْ يَأْتِ أَحَدٌ بِأَفْضَلَ مِمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ، إِلاَّ أَحَدٌ عَمِلَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏‏.‏

L62: باب فَضْلِ مَنْ بَاتَ عَلَى الْوُضُوءِ
L63: 
L64: Sahih al-Bukhari 247
L65: 
L66: Narrated Al-Bara 'bin `Azib:
L67: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to me, "Whenever you go to bed perform ablution like that for the prayer, lie or your right side and say, "Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilaika, wa fauwadtu `Amri ilaika, wa alja'tu Zahri ilaika raghbatan wa rahbatan ilaika. La Malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilaika. Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta wa bina-biyika-l ladhi arsalta" (O Allah! I surrender to You and entrust all my affairs to You and depend upon You for Your Blessings both with hope and fear of You.
L68: There is no fleeing from You, and there is no place of protection and safety except with You O Allah! I believe in Your Book (the Qur'an) which You have revealed and in Your Prophet (Muhammad) whom You have sent). Then if you die on that very night, you will die with faith (i.e. or the religion of Islam).
L69: Let the aforesaid words be your last utterance (before sleep)." I repeated it before the Prophet (ﷺ) and when I reached "Allahumma amantu bikitabika-l-ladhi anzalta (O Allah I believe in Your Book which You have revealed)." I said, "Wa-rasulika (and your Apostle)." The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "No, (but say): 'Wanabiyika-l-ladhi arsalta (Your Prophet whom You have sent), instead."
L70: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ】، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا 【11†عَبْدُ اللَّهِ】، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا 【12†سُفْيَانُ】، عَنْ 【13†مَنْصُورٍ】، عَنْ 【14†سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ】، عَنِ 【15†الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ】، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أَتَيْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ، ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ، ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ فَأَنْتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، وَاجْعَلْهُنَّ آخِرَ مَا تَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ ‏" ‏‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَدَّدْتُهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا بَلَغْتُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَرَسُولِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ، وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏"‏‏.‏

L58: Thauban reported:
L59: When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) finished his prayer. He begged forgiveness three times and said: O Allah! Thou art Peace, and peace comes from Thee; Blessed art Thou, O Possessor of Glory and Honour. Walid reported: I said to Auza'i: How is the seeking of forgiveness? He replied: You should say: I beg forgiveness from Allah, I beg forgiveness from Allah."
L60: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【11†الْوَلِيدُ】، عَنِ 【12†الأَوْزَاعِيِّ】، عَنْ 【13†أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، - اسْمُهُ شَدَّادُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ】 - عَنْ 【14†أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ】، عَنْ 【15†ثَوْبَانَ】، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا انْصَرَفَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ اسْتَغْفَرَ ثَلاَثًا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ فَقُلْتُ لِلأَوْزَاعِيِّ كَيْفَ الاِسْتِغْفَارُ قَالَ تَقُولُ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ‏.‏

L240: ##### - "ما أصابَ أحدًا قَطُّ هَمٌّ ولا حَزَنٌ، فقال: اللَّهُمَّ إنِّي عبدُكَ، ابنُ عبدِكَ، ابنُ أَمتِكَ، ناصيَتي بيَدِكَ، ماضٍ فيَّ حُكمُكَ، عَدلٌ فيَّ قَضاؤكَ، أسأَلُكَ بكلِّ اسمٍ هو لك، سمَّيتَ به نفْسَكَ، أو علَّمتَه أحدًا مِن خلْقِكَ، أو أنزَلتَه في كتابِكَ، أو استَأثَرتَ به في عِلمِ الغَيبِ عندَك، أنْ تجعَلَ القُرآنَ رَبيعَ قلبي ، ونورَ صَدري، وجِلاءَ حُزني، وذَهابَ هَمِّي؛ إلَّا أذهَبَ اللهُ هَمَّه وحُزنَه، وأبدَلَه مكانَه فَرحًا"، قال: فقيلَ: يا رسولَ اللهِ، ألَا نتعلَّمُها؟ فقال: "بلى، يَنبَغي لمَن سمِعَها أنْ يتعلَّمَها".

L249: ##### [مسند أحمد] (6/ 246 ط الرسالة)
L250: ((3712- حدثنا يزيد، أخبرنا فضيل بن مرزوق، حدثنا أبو سلمة الجهني، عن القاسم بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه، عن عبد الله، قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: (( ما أصاب أحدا قط هم ولا حزن، فقال: اللهم إني عبدك، ابن عبدك، ابن أمتك ناصيتي بيدك، ماض في حكمك، عدل في قضاؤك، أسألك بكل اسم هو لك سميت به نفسك، أو علمته أحدا من خلقك، أو أنزلته في كتابك، أو استأثرت به في علم الغيب عندك، أن تجعل القرآن ربيع قلبي، ونور صدري، وجلاء حزني، وذهاب همي، إلا أذهب الله همه وحزنه، وأبدله مكانه فرحا))، قال: فقيل: يا رسول الله، ألا نتعلمها؟ فقال: (( بلى، ينبغي لمن سمعها أن يتعلمها)).
L251: ﻿
L252: ##### مصنف ابن أبي شيبة- ترقيم عوامة (10/ 253)
L253: 29930- حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، عن فضيل بن مرزوق قال: حدثنا أبو سلمة الجهني، عن القاسم بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه، عن ابن مسعود قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: ما قال عبد قط إذا أصابه هم، أو حزن: اللهم إني عبدك ابن عبدك ابن أمتك، ناصيتي بيدك، ماض في حكمك عدل في قضاؤك، أسألك بكل اسم هو لك سميت به نفسك، أو أنزلته في كتابك، أو علمته أحدا من خلقك، أو استأثرت به في علم الغيب عندك أن تجعل القرآن ربيع قلبي ونور صدري وجلاء حزني وذهاب همي إلا أذهب الله همه وأبدله مكان حزنه فرحا، قالوا: يا رسول الله، ينبغي لنا أن نتعلم هؤلاء الكلمات؟ قال: أجل، ينبغي لمن سمعهن أن يتعلمهن.
L254: ﻿
L255: ##### [مسند البزار - البحر الزخار] (5/ 363)
L256: ‌1994- حدثنا إسحاق بن بهلول، قال: نا إسحاق بن عيسى، قال: نا محمد بن صالح الثقفي، قال: نا عبد الرحمن بن إسحاق، عن القاسم بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبيه، عن عبد الله بن مسعود قال: كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلمنا هذا الدعاء: ((اللهم إني عبدك، ابن عبدك، ابن أمتك، ناصيتي بيدك، ماض في حكمك، نافذ في قضاؤك، أسألك بكل اسم سميت به نفسك، أو أنزلته في كتابك، أو علمته أحدا من خلقك، أو استأثرت به في علم الغيب عندك، أن تجعل القرآن ربيع قلبي، ونور صدري، وجلاء حزني، وذهاب غمي، إلا أذهب الله غمه وأبدله بحزنه فرحا))، قالوا: يا رسول الله، ينبغي لنا أن نتعلم هؤلاء الكلمات قال: ((أجل ينبغي لمن سمعهن أن يتعلمهن)).

L56: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3364
L57: 
L58: Abu Al-Aliyah narrated from Ubayy bin Ka’b:
L59: “The idolaters were saying to the Messenger of Allah: ‘Name the lineage of your Lord for us.’ So Allah, Most High, revealed: Say: “He is Allah, the One. Allah As-Samad.” So As-Samad is ‘the One Who does not beget, nor is He begotten,’ because there is nothing born except it will die, and there is nothing that dies except that it will be inherited from, and verily. Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, does not die, nor is He inherited from.
L60: ‘And there is none comparable to Him.’ He said: ‘There is nothing similar to Him, nor equal to Him, nor is there anything like Him.’”
L61: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【11†أَبُو سَعْدٍ، هُوَ الصَّغَانِيُّ】 عَنْ 【12†أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيِّ】، عَنِ 【13†الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ】، عَنْ 【14†أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ】، عَنْ 【15†أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ】، أَنَّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، قَالُوا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْسُبْ لَنَا رَبَّكَ ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏:‏ ‏‏(‏ قلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ‏)‏ فَالصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ لأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ يُولَدُ إِلاَّ سَيَمُوتُ وَلَيْسَ شَيْءٌ يَمُوتُ إِلاَّ سَيُورَثُ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لاَ يَمُوتُ وَلاَ يُورَثُ ‏:‏ ‏‏(‏ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ ‏)‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَبِيهٌ وَلاَ عِدْلٌ وَلَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

L62: Narrated Abu Huraira:
L63: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah said: 'The son of Adam tells a lie against Me,, though he hasn't the right to do so. He abuses me though he hasn't the right to do so. As for his telling a lie against Me, it is his saying that I will not recreate him as I created him for the first time. In fact, the first creation was not easier for Me than new creation.
L64: As for his abusing Me, it is his saying that Allah has begotten children, while I am the One, the Self-Sufficient Master Whom all creatures need, I beget not, nor was I begotten, and there is none like unto Me."
L65: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†أَبُو الْيَمَانِ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【11†شُعَيْبٌ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【12†أَبُو الزِّنَادِ】، عَنِ 【13†الأَعْرَجِ】، عَنْ 【14†أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ】 ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ كَذَّبَنِي ابْنُ آدَمَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ، وَشَتَمَنِي وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ، فَأَمَّا تَكْذِيبُهُ إِيَّاىَ فَقَوْلُهُ لَنْ يُعِيدَنِي كَمَا بَدَأَنِي، وَلَيْسَ أَوَّلُ الْخَلْقِ بِأَهْوَنَ عَلَىَّ مِنْ إِعَادَتِهِ، وَأَمَّا شَتْمُهُ إِيَّاىَ فَقَوْلُهُ اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ وَلَدًا، وَأَنَا الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ أَلِدْ وَلَمْ أُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لِي كُفْأً أَحَدٌ ‏"‏‏.‏

L62: Sunan Abi Dawud 1463
L63: 
L64: Narrated Uqbah ibn Amir:
L65: 
L66: White I was travelling with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) between al-Juhfah and al-Abwa', a wind and intense darkness enveloped us, whereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) began to seek refuge in Allah, reciting: "I seek refuge in the Lord of the dawn," and "I seek refuge in the Lord of men."
L67: He then said: Uqbah, use them when seeking refuge in Allah, for no one can use anything to compare with them for the purpose.
L68: 
L69: Uqbah added: I heard him reciting them when he led the people in prayer.
L70: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【11†مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ】، عَنْ 【12†مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ】، عَنْ 【13†سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ】، عَنْ 【14†أَبِيهِ】، عَنْ 【15†عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ】، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا أَسِيرُ، مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الْجُحْفَةِ وَالأَبْوَاءِ إِذْ غَشِيَتْنَا رِيحٌ وَظُلْمَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَعَوَّذُ بِـ ‏‏{‏ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ‏}‏ وَ ‏‏{‏ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ‏}‏ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَا عُقْبَةُ تَعَوَّذْ بِهِمَا فَمَا تَعَوَّذَ مُتَعَوِّذٌ بِمِثْلِهِمَا ‏" ‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَؤُمُّنَا بِهِمَا فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏.‏

L56: Sahih Muslim 810
L57: 
L58: Ubayy b. Ka'b said:
L59: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O Abu' al-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ) know best. He again said: Abu'l-Mundhir, do you know the verse from the Book of Allah which, according to you, is the greatest? I said: Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Eternal. Thereupon he struck me on my breast and said: May knowledge be pleasant for you, O Abu'l-Mundhir!
L60: حَدَّثَنَا 【10†أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ】، حَدَّثَنَا 【11†عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى】، عَنِ 【12†الْجُرَيْرِيِّ】، عَنْ 【13†أَبِي السَّلِيلِ】، عَنْ 【14†عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ】، عَنْ 【15†أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ】، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏" ‏ يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ أَتَدْرِي أَىُّ آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَعَكَ أَعْظَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ أَتَدْرِي أَىُّ آيَةٍ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَعَكَ أَعْظَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَىُّ الْقَيُّومُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَضَرَبَ فِي صَدْرِي وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لِيَهْنِكَ الْعِلْمُ أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏

L56: What has been said about Fãtihat al-Kitab (i.e., the Opening of the Book)
